task: Independent aliasing, pitch-bend restoration and fractional-register review
result: Host-Nyquist and downward-bend probes pass; demonstrated piano onset timbre discontinuity at fractional-note harmonic-budget thresholds. Production fix recommended to decouple coupled-course random draws from principal mode count.

existing_test_evidence.note: Existing log and test implementation reviewed; full suite not rerun by worker32.

measurement_methods: Guard: noteOn piano MIDI36 configures all42 principal modes plus6 coupled modes. Playback frequency positions tested harmonic25/32/42 at0.6*host rate; arbitrary-frequency Hann-window DFT measures its mathematically known fold after stride2 decimation without any external decimation filter. DFT interval0.04–0.16 seconds. A scratch-only guard-disabled positive control proves sensitivity. Measured small production projection is a residual/leakage bound, not a claim that every arbitrary nonharmonic component is an alias.

Bend: noteOn piano110 at decay4, tick high pitch until0.10s then abruptly tick MIDI48; DFT harmonic12 over0.28–0.58s compares against same onset voicing/envelope always played at48. Scratch positive control permanently culls modes at noteOn host guard and loses the target. Phases need not match; modal magnitude is the comparison.

Budget: pair noteOn values boundary±epsilon at identical playback frequency, seed and controls. Equal-RMS residual uses0.02–1.18s; nearby control uses center+0.05±epsilon. Tested boundaries60,56,40,37.333333333333; epsilon0.001,0.0001,0.00001; seeds812,317. Residual persists as epsilon tends to float resolution. First-six spectral measurements use exact stretched modal frequencies over0.2–1.1s.

Causal counterfactual: save RNG state before principal modes; before coupled modes restore that state and advance exactly24 draws. This keeps coupled-mode/texture random draws independent of ceil(harmonicBudget). It is a scratch demonstration, not a prescribed production patch.

finding.severity: actionable onset timbre continuity defect; no claim of running-note click or measured listener audibility
finding.cause: ceil(harmonicBudget) changes principal loop length. A newly admitted almost-zero-amplitude partial still consumes randomBipolar for phase. That shifts coupled-mode detuning and phases, and subsequent hit-noise RNG state; coverage interpolation alone cannot ensure waveform/timbre continuity.

production_reachability.reason: Engine bodyNote is float computed from targetPitch (Scala/MTS capable), masterTune, channel2 detuneCents, tuningRef and footage. It passes directly to InstrumentBody::noteOn; arbitrary fractional boundaries are reachable when starting notes with those settings. Live ribbon/vibrato alone changes tick frequency and does not rebuild the excitation, so this seam is an onset voicing seam.
production_reachability.seed_caveat: Engine also varies seed with voice age for intentionally different strikes. The fixed-seed comparison isolates deterministic tuning dependence and does not assert successive ordinary MIDI strikes otherwise match.

finding.recommendation: Stabilize coupled-course random draws independently of principal-mode count, retain intended strike variability, and add a small-epsilon boundary regression. Review other physical register laws separately; no production edits made by worker32.

limitations: Body-layer output only; panel filters, VCA, effects and host resampling are excluded.
Focused probe selects piano mode25/32/42 and one downward-bend mode; it does not establish universal alias-free output.

Host guard applies to modal center frequencies; smooth onset and effort modulation have sidebands. Existing onset/regression tests were inspected, but this probe does not measure all modulation sidebands.
Authored stiffness/doublets and contact noise are intentional; no blanket attribution of nonharmonic spectrum to aliasing.
No acoustic-recording comparison or perceptual listening threshold was established.
Fractional voicing seam is not a running-note discontinuity, and equal-RMS residual magnitude is not equivalent to perceived loudness difference.

reproduction.compiler_warning: The intentionally guard-disabled positive-control header leaves its local t unused. No production warning was generated.
